# Claude Code CLI

`claude` is the command that starts Claude Code.
Alone it opens a chat in your terminal, and with `-p` it answers once and exits, which is how scripts and CI jobs use it.
The command has flags that change one run, and subcommands for tasks such as sign-in and plugins.

## Example

```bash
claude                                   # chat
claude "explain this project"            # chat with a first prompt
claude -p "list the TODOs" > todos.txt   # one answer, then exit
git diff | claude -p "review this diff"  # pipe in text
```

## Ways to Start

Source: [CLI Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference) and [Run Claude Code Programmatically](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless).

| Command | Mark | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `claude` | ✅ | Starts an interactive session. |
| `claude "query"` | ✅ | Starts an interactive session with a first prompt. |
| `claude -p "query"` | ✅ | Prints one answer and exits, and it skips the trust dialog, so use it only in folders you trust. |
| `cmd \| claude -p "query"` | ✅ | Prints one answer for the text that you pipe in. |
| `claude -c`, `claude -r "<session>"` | ✅ | Continues or resumes a session (see [Sessions and Storage](Claude-Code-Sessions-And-Storage)). |
| `claude --bg "query"` | ✅ | Starts a background session, and `claude agents` lists the sessions. |
| `claude --bare` | ✅ | Starts with no hooks, plugins, MCP servers, auto memory, or `CLAUDE.md` discovery, and sets `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE=1`. |
| `claude --safe-mode` | ✅ | Starts with all customizations off to debug a broken setup, and sets `CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE=1`. |
| `claude --restricted` | ✅ | Removes the tools that run code, and ignores user, project, and local settings. |
| `claude --cloud`, `--environment`, `--teleport` | ✅ | Work with cloud sessions. |

## Print Mode

| Item | Mark | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--output-format text\|json\|stream-json` | ✅ | `json` gives one result object, and `stream-json` gives one JSON line for each event (see [CLI Stream JSON](Claude-Code-CLI-Stream-Json)). |
| `--input-format text\|stream-json` | ✅ | `stream-json` reads JSON lines from stdin. |
| `--include-partial-messages`, `--include-hook-events`, `--forward-subagent-text`, `--replay-user-messages` | ✅ | Add events to the stream, with `stream-json` only. |
| `--json-schema <schema>` | ✅ | Checks the final answer against a JSON Schema. |
| `--max-budget-usd <amount>` | ✅ | Stops at a spend limit. |
| `--max-turns <n>` | ✅ | Stops after `n` agent turns, and the flag is hidden in `--help`. |
| `--permission-prompts host\|none` | ✅ | `none` denies everything that would ask. |
| `--permission-prompt-tool <tool>` | ✅ | Lets an MCP tool answer permission prompts, and the flag is hidden in `--help`. |
| `--no-session-persistence` | ✅ | Writes no transcript. |
| `--init`, `--init-only`, `--maintenance` | ✅ | Run `Setup` hooks, and the flags are hidden in `--help`. |

The result of `--output-format json` has a `usage` field.
Its `cache_creation` part is split into `ephemeral_1h_input_tokens` and `ephemeral_5m_input_tokens`.
Source: [How Claude Code Uses Prompt Caching](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/prompt-caching#choose-the-ttl-yourself).

## Subcommands

`claude --help` lists 18 commands.
[CLI Flags](Claude-Code-CLI-Flags) and [CLI Hidden Flags](Claude-Code-CLI-Hidden-Flags) list every flag.
The text below comes from `claude <command> --help` of `2.1.303`.

| Command | Mark | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `claude agents` | ✅ | Opens the agent view to watch and start background sessions, and `--json` prints the active sessions. |
| `claude attach <id\|name>` | ✅ | Opens a background session. |
| `claude logs <id\|name>` | ✅ | Prints the recent output of a background session. |
| `claude stop <id>` (alias `kill`) | ✅ | Stops a background session and keeps the conversation. |
| `claude respawn <id>` or `--all` | ✅ | Restarts a background session on the current binary. |
| `claude rm <id>` | ✅ | Deletes a background session and its worktree when that is safe. |
| `claude daemon [run\|status\|logs\|stop\|uninstall]` | ✅ | Controls the supervisor of background sessions, which the root help does not list. |
| `claude auth login\|logout\|status` | ✅ | Signs you in and out, and `status` exits with 1 when you are not signed in. |
| `claude setup-token` | ✅ | Makes a long-lived token, and it needs a subscription. |
| `claude auto-mode config\|critique\|defaults\|reset` | ✅ | Shows or resets the rules of the auto mode classifier. |
| `claude doctor` | ✅ | Checks your setup and changes nothing. |
| `claude gateway --config <yaml>` | ✅ | Runs the enterprise gateway. |
| `claude import [codex\|gemini\|cursor]` | ✅ | Imports the config of another agent, with `--dry-run` and `--yes`. |
| `claude install [stable\|latest\|version]` | ✅ | Installs the native build, with `--force`. |
| `claude update` (alias `upgrade`) | ✅ | Updates Claude Code. |
| `claude mcp ...` | ✅ | Manages MCP servers (see [MCP](Claude-Code-MCP)). |
| `claude plugin ...` (alias `plugins`) | ✅ | Manages plugins (see [Plugins](Claude-Code-Plugins)). |
| `claude plugin test [dir]` | ✅ | Runs the tests of a mod. |
| `claude purge [path]` | ✅ | Deletes the state of a project, with `--all`, `--dry-run`, `-i`, and `-y`. |
| `claude remote-control` (alias `rc`) | ✅ | Lets you control local sessions from `claude.ai` or the mobile app. |
| `claude ultrareview [target]` | ✅ | Starts a cloud review with many agents, with `--json`, `--post`, and `--timeout`. |
| `claude self-hosted-runner` | ✅ | Runs cloud sessions on your machine, and the root help does not list it. |
| `claude project purge` | ❌ | A hidden command that now only prints that it is `claude purge`. |
| `claude sandbox` | 🔍 | A hidden command, and the docs have no help for it. |
| `claude edit-hook`, `edit-permission-rules`, `edit-memory-settings`, `edit-skill-overrides`, `edit-sandbox-settings`, `edit-chrome-settings`, `drop-worktree-registrations`, `design-login` | 🔍 | Hidden commands that read one JSON edit from stdin with `--json`, and their text says they serve the VS Code extension. |
| `claude import-conversations <exportPath>` | 🔍 | A hidden command that archives an export, with `--cwd` and `--dry-run`. |
